newsitem.title: USA: Abbott CEO 1996 pay up $1.5 mln over 1995.
newsitem.headline: Abbott CEO 1996 pay up $1.5 mln over 1995.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories Inc chairman and chief executive Duane Burnham received total compensation in 1996 of $3.76 million, including restricted stock awards worth $1.31 million, according to the drugmaker's proxy statement released Wednesday.
In 1995, Burnham's total pay was $2.26 million, which included no restricted stock awards, the proxy said.

Burnham received stock options in 1996 for 210,000 Abbott common shares. The options are exercisable in increments over time at a base price of $43.70 per share. Abbott shares were trading early Wednesday unchanged at 59-1/8.
Abbott president and chief operating officer Thomas Hodgson received 1996 total compensation of $2.27 million, including restricted stock awards worth $733,950.
